summary: Check if number and revision entered are available or duplicated.
description: Returns if the number and revision entered are available or duplicated. When duplicated, it returns the next_number attribute with the next available number.

number_available.description: Whether the requested number and revision are available (not already used by another submittal on the project).

next_number.description: Next available submittal number. Only returned when the requested number is not available (`number_available` is false).

current_number.description: The requested number that was checked. Only returned when the requested number is not available (`number_available` is false).
